claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down at approximately 5:07 p.m. PDT.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down at 8:07 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission crew is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission crew will be recovered by the U.S. Navy and USS John P. Murtha.
